An OpenTofu (Terraform) plan is about to be applied to an AWS account (one region). Running applications use these resources by name: they read and write objects, table items, queue messages, secrets and parameters, and invoke functions. Applying the plan carries out the resource changes below in dependency order. Replacing a resource destroys the old one and then creates the new one, unless the plan says the new one is created first (create_before_destroy). If a change fails, the apply stops there; the changes already made stay made.
